I have 0.57 hectares here, and with my other plots making up about 3.71 hectares total, I must spread my resources carefully. This plot is for "other" crops — maybe some pulses or root crops alongside what we eat at home. I'll get a little DAP from the cooperative if it comes in time, but fertilizer is expensive and often arrives late, so I won't put much on this smaller plot. I keep a few oxen and the manure from them goes onto my plots near the house. My sons and wife help with the work, and during weeding and harvest I may hire one or two neighbors for a few days.
